cases.description: Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: a negative serial is #NUM!

The engine's answer, by generalisation, asked of Excel: MINUTE gives #NUM! for any serial below 0 and does not cut it down to its day, as the nine functions the second area pass of 2026-10-12 asked do at -0.5 (YEAR-008 and its kin); Excel was observed to answer #NUM! at -1 under DATEDIF, YEARFRAC and MINUTE (DATEDIF-045, YEARFRAC-056, MINUTE-002), and between -1 and 0 no run has read it: read as a time of day, -0.5 is 12:00, and MINUTE is 0. Whether the engine refuses here instead, as the readings part, is open (docs/agents/proposals/area-corrections-apply.md)
